mapper.select: SELECT 2 AS used , t1.NCOD AS ncod , t1.EXID AS exid , t1.EXCD AS excd , t1.EXNM AS exnm , t1.SYMB AS symb , t1.RSYM AS rsym , t1.KNAM AS knam , t1.ENAM AS enam , t1.STIS AS stis , t1.CURR AS curr , t1.ZDIV AS zdiv , t1.ZTYP AS ztyp , t1.BASE AS basePrice , t1.BNIT AS bnit , t1.ANIT AS anit , SUBSTR ('00' || t1.MSTM,-4) AS mstm , t1.METM AS metm , t1.ISDR AS isdr , t1.DRCD AS drcd , t1.ICOD AS icod , t1.SJONG AS sjong , t1.TTYP AS ttyp , CASE WHEN t1.ETYP IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE SUBSTR ('000' || t1.ETYP,-3) END AS etyp , t1.TTYP_SB AS ttypSb , ya.CORP_GR AS corpGr , ya.JM_CD AS jmCd , ya.JM_NM AS jmNm , ya.JASAN_GB AS jasanGb , ya.SEQ_NO AS seqNo , ya.BALH_NATION AS balhNation , ya.CURRENCY AS currency , TO_CHAR(ya.SANGJ_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS sangjYmd , ya.SANGJ_JUSU AS sangjJusu , ya.BLBG_TCKR AS blbgTckr , ya.ISIN_CD AS isinCd , ya.SEDOL AS sedol , ya.STOCK_GB AS stockGb , ya.SJ_GB AS sjGb , ya.BLBG_TCKR_TEXT AS blbgTckrText , ya.SRS_CD AS srsCd , ya.EXCD AS sym0yaExcd , TO_CHAR(ya.USPM_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS uspmYmd , ya.OPT_UNIT AS optUnit , ya.OPT_1UNIT AS opt1unit , ya.OPT_2UNIT AS opt2unit , ya.OPT_4UNIT AS opt4unit , ya.OPT_5UNIT AS opt5unit FROM API_GLOBAL_MASTCODE t1 , SYM0YA ya WHERE ya.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND ya.JASAN_GB = '1' AND ya.BLBG_TCKR = t1.SYMB UNION ALL SELECT 1 AS used , t1.NCOD AS ncod , t1.EXID AS exid , t1.EXCD AS excd , t1.EXNM AS exnm , t1.SYMB AS symb , t1.RSYM AS rsym , t1.KNAM AS knam , t1.ENAM AS enam , t1.STIS AS stis , t1.CURR AS curr , t1.ZDIV AS zdiv , t1.ZTYP AS ztyp , t1.BASE AS basePrice , t1.BNIT AS bnit , t1.ANIT AS anit , SUBSTR ('00' || t1.MSTM,-4) AS mstm , t1.METM AS metm , t1.ISDR AS isdr , t1.DRCD AS drcd , t1.ICOD AS icod , t1.SJONG AS sjong , t1.TTYP AS ttyp , CASE WHEN t1.ETYP IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE SUBSTR ('000' || t1.ETYP,-3) END AS etyp , t1.TTYP_SB AS ttypSb , NULL AS corpGr , NULL AS jmCd , NULL AS jmNm , NULL AS jasanGb , NULL AS seqNo , NULL AS balhNation , NULL AS currency , NULL AS sangjYmd , NULL AS sangjJusu , NULL AS blbgTckr , NULL AS isinCd , NULL AS sedol , NULL AS stockGb , NULL AS sjGb , NULL AS blbgTckrText , NULL AS srsCd , NULL AS sym0yaExcd , NULL AS uspmYmd , NULL AS optUnit , NULL AS opt1unit , NULL AS opt2unit , NULL AS opt4unit , NULL AS opt5unit FROM API_GLOBAL_MASTCODE t1 WHERE t1.SYMB NOT IN (SELECT BLBG_TCKR FROM SYM0YA ya WHERE ya.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND ya.JASAN_GB = '1') ORDER BY used DESC, symb ASC

SELECT t1.CORP_GR AS corpGr , TO_CHAR(t1.YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd , t1.JM_CD AS jmCd , t1.JONGA AS jonga , t1.DANGA AS danga , TO_CHAR(t1.LOAD_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS loadTime , TO_CHAR(t1.PX_CLOSE_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS pxCloseDt , t1.PX_LAST AS pxLast , TO_CHAR(t1.PX_DT_1D, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS pxDt1d , t1.PX_CLOSE_1D AS pxClose1d , t1.PX_YEST_CLOSE_EXCH_UNADJ AS pxYestCloseExchUnadj , t1.BLBG_TCKR AS blbgTckr , t1.ISIN_CD AS isinCd , t1.CURRENCY AS currency , t1.HANGSA_GA AS hangsaGa , t1.BID AS bid , t1.ASK AS ask , t1.TIME_GA AS timeGa , t1.TVOL AS tvol , t1.TAMT AS tamt , t1.SHAR AS shar , t1.TOMV AS tomv , t1.T_RATE AS tRate , t1.TRD_TO_DATE AS trdToDate , TO_CHAR(t1.YMD, 'iw') AS week FROM SYT0LP t1 WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.YMD >= ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), -13) AND t1.YMD NOT IN (SELECT HOLI_YMD FROM SZX0HL ta WHERE ta.NATION_CD = 'US' AND ta.HOLI_YMD >= ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), -13)) AND t1.JM_CD = #{jmCd} ORDER BY t1.YMD DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO API_Q ( COMPANY , URL , HEADERS , QUERYPARAMS , TABLENAME , SUBTABLE , REQUEST , API_KEY , KEY_VALUE , SUB_KEY_VALUE , CORP_GR , TR_YMD , KEY1 ) SELECT COMPANY , URL , HEADERS , REPLACE (REPLACE (QUERYPARAMS, '@prdt', #{prdt}), '@pdno', #{symb}) , TABLENAME , SUBTABLE , '0' , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') || '-' || RAWTOHEX(SYS_GUID()) , KEY_VALUE , SUB_KEY_VALUE , #{corpGr} , SYSDATE , #{key1} FROM API_PARAMS t1 WHERE t1.TR_CO_CD = '00003' AND t1.GR_CD = '13' AND t1.SCD = '09' AND t1.COMPANY = 'KB_REAL'
